method_notes: The executor labels learning and evaluation items under the current guideline. Labeling visibility does not grant development access.

Only learning-set item content, item-level errors, and associated human judgments enter the guideline-development context. Evaluation execution, reference scoring, and guideline writing use separate contexts.
Aggregate validation feedback may select candidate versions. Repeated selection makes that split validation, not an independent final test.
Meaning development produces a versioned structured adaptive guideline and human-approved learning reference labels. Predictions and propagated labels retain separate provenance and approval status.
Pending human decisions remain provisional. The agent may continue unrelated exploration asynchronously.

Diagnostic annotations accompany the task label. Suggested fields: difficulty (easy, hard, unknown); uncertainty_status (resolved, ambiguous, insufficient_evidence, unknown); uncertainty_reasons (missing_context, rule_overlap, unclear_boundary, other); review_action (accept_candidate, review, defer). These are draft categories requiring task-specific definitions.
Difficulty is relative to a stated task, available context, and assessor. A superficially complex item may have a clear answer. Model agreement or confidence is not proof of correctness.

The guideline defines criteria, contrastive examples, confusion triggers, abstention and review actions for diagnostic annotations. Difficulty and uncertainty remain separate from the substantive task label.
Store diagnostic assessor, guideline version, and executor version with each record. Keep human-reported difficulty distinct from model-reported uncertainty and measured cross-model disagreement.
Prioritize learning review using diagnostic flags plus random and coverage sampling; do not inspect only self-reported hard cases.
Diagnostics may be produced for evaluation items, but their individual contents and reasons remain in the evaluation context. Predefined aggregate strata may be reported.
No model weights are updated; no executor experiment is run by drawing this diagram.
